enroute to his office and before entering heard one of the local aircraft
in the traffic pattern. Looking up he observed the aircraft and slightly
to the left he saw 2 silver objects of either spherical or disc-like shape
moving about 300 MPH at approximately 8000 ft heading about 320° due north.
He immediately called S/Sgt Gerald E. Nauman, T/Sgt Joseph Ruvolo and Miss
Jannette Marie Scotte. Witnesses all verified the sighting and the direction
of the objects - all three stated that the objects were moving toward Mojave,
Calif.

観察記録（続き）:
事務所へ向かう途中、搭乗前に周回する地元機の一機の音を聞いた。見上げるとその航空機が見え、やや左側に直径球状または円盤状の銀色物体2個が約8,000フィートでおよそ300マイル/時の速度で320°、北向きに移動しているのを見た。彼は直ちにS/Sgt Gerald E. Nauman、T/Sgt Joseph Ruvolo、Miss Jannette Marie Scotteを呼んだ。目撃者全員が目撃および物体の方向を確認し、3名とも物体はカリフォルニア州Mojave方向へ移動していると述べた。

Witness was sure it was not an optical illusion or that the objects were not
weather balloons since they traveled against prevailing wind and since the
speed at which they traveled and the horizontal direction taken indicated
that they were not weather balloons. Furthermore they could not remain at
the same altitude so consistently if they were weather balloons.
Witness then attempted to get personnel (medical officers) to further verify
the sighting but by the time the additional personnel had arrived at the
scene the original objects had disappeared due to the speed at which they were
traveling. However, two of them sighted a third object of a silver spherical
or disc-like nature at approximately 8000 ft traveling in circles over the
north end of the airfield. Five out of the seven personnel saw this object
All looked away from the object several times to make sure there was no eye
strain. He stated that this object performed too tight a circle to be
any type of known aircraft.

目撃者は、物体が優勢な風に逆らって移動していたこと、移動速度およびとった水平方向から、光学的錯覚や気象観測用気球ではないと確信していた。さらに、もし気球であれば高度をこれほど安定して保つことはできないだろうとも述べている。目撃者は更なる確認のために（医務将校などの）人員を呼ぼうとしたが、追加人員が現場に到着した時には、元の物体はその速さのために既に消失していた。しかしながら、そのうち2名は北側飛行場上空約8,000フィートで円を描いて飛行する銀色の球状または円盤状の第3の物体を目撃した。7名中5名がこの物体を見た。全員、目の疲れがないことを確かめるために数回目をそらしてから再び確かめている。彼は、この物体が描いた円は既知のいかなる航空機のものにしてはあまりに小さいと述べた。

Evaluation: Confirmed by other sources.

Joseph Ruvolo and S/Sgt. Gerald E. Nauman to the front of the B.O.Q. "A" Bldg.
Pointing up in a direction directly above the group he asked them to explain
what they saw. Witness states that she saw 2 silver-colored disc-like objects
flying toward Mojave, Calif, one directly back of the other, at a speed of
about 300 to 400 MPH at an altitude of approximately 8,000 ft. She listened
carefully for a few minutes but could hear no drone such as occasioned by any
aircraft. Casting her eyes for a moment in another direction and then looking
back to the same spot she was able to distinguish the same objects again.
Assured that it was not eye-strain, she was convinced the objects were not
weather balloons due to the horizontal position in which they traveled. Nor
could they have been birds since they reflected the sun's rays.

Joseph RuvoloおよびS/Sgt. Gerald E. NaumanをB.O.Q.「A」棟前に呼び、群れの真上を指さして彼らに見たものを説明するよう求めた。目撃者は、2個の銀色の円盤状物体が300〜400マイル/時程度の速度で約8,000フィートの高度で一列になってMojave, Calif方向へ飛行しているのを見たと述べている。数分間注意深く耳を澄ませたが、いかなる航空機に伴うような連続した轟音も聞こえなかった。目を一瞬他の方向に向けてから同じ場所を見ると、同じ物体を再びはっきりと確認できた。眼精疲労ではないことを確信し、また物体が水平位置で飛行していたため気象観測用気球ではないと確信した。太陽光を反射していたため鳥でもあり得ないとも述べている。

Some three or four minues after the objects had nearly disappeared she saw
another flying object similar to the above-mentioned objects. It was silver
colored and disc-like in shape. Unlike the first two, it flew in a tight circle,
neither losing nor gaining altitude, at approximately 8,000 ft. She thought
it performed too tight a circle to have been any type aircraft with which she
was familiar.

約3〜4分後、最初の物体群がほとんど見えなくなった頃、彼女は前述の物体に似た別の飛行物体を見た。それは銀色で円盤状だった。最初の2個とは異なり、約8,000フィートで高度を上下させずにきつい円を描いて飛んでいた。彼女はその描いた円が、彼女が知っているどの種の航空機のものとしても狭すぎると考えた。

About 0945 Lt McHenry, Billeting Officer in Charge, upon returning from the
Post Exchange contacted the witness, Sgt Puvol and asked him to look up in
the sky.  Witness observed two (2) flying objects which appeared like two
flying discs or saucer-shaped silver-colored objects flying in a northwestern
direction at approximately 350 to 400 MPH at an altitude of about 7500 or
8000 ft.  He could hear no motor roar and was positive that it was not a
balloon.

約0945、中尉McHenry（宿泊担当将校）がPost Exchangeから戻った際、目撃者Sgt Puvolに連絡して空を見上げるように頼んだ。目撃者は北西方向へ飛行する、2個の飛行円盤またはソーサー状の銀色物体を観察した。速度は約350〜400マイル/時、高度は約7,500〜8,000フィートだった。エンジンの轟音は聞こえず、それが気球ではないことを確信していた。

He states:  "I am of good health and sound mind and this was no hallucination"


彼は次のように述べている: 「私は健康で正気であり、これは幻覚ではなかった」

REMARKS:

     Statement given by Major J. C. Wise, Test Pilot, Muroc Army Air Field,
Muroc, California.

     On 7 July 1947, at approximately 10:10, while running up the XP-84 on
the ground I noticed everyone was looking up into the air.  Off to the
north about 10,000 to 12,000 feet altitude, was an object that I assumed
at first to be a weather balloon, but after looking at it for a while I
noticed that it was oscillating in a forward whirling movement without
losing altitude.  It was traveling about 200 to 225 MPH, and heading from west
to east.

     The object was yellowish white in color and I would estimate that
it was a sphere about 5 to 10 feet in diameter.

備考:

     Muroc陸軍飛行場、カリフォルニア州Murocのテストパイロット、Major J. C. Wiseによる陳述。

     1947年7月7日、およそ10:10、地上でXP-84のエンジンを暖機していた際、皆が空を見上げているのに気づいた。北方およそ10,000〜12,000フィートの高度に、当初は気象観測用気球だと思われる物体があったが、しばらく観察すると高度を失わずに前方へ渦を巻くような振動運動をしていることに気づいた。速度は約200〜225マイル/時で、西から東へ向かっていた。

summaryJa: 1947年7月7–8日、カリフォルニア州Muroc陸軍飛行場（Muroc AAFld）で複数の未確認飛行物体が目撃された記録。主な報告は以下。 (1) 1947年7月8日 09:30頃、1st Lt Joseph C. McHenryが高度約8,000ft、速度約300mphで北方（320°）へ飛行する銀色の円盤状または球状物体2個を目撃。S/Sgt Gerald E. Nauman、T/Sgt Joseph Ruvolo、Jannette M. Scottらが確認。後に同高度で円を描く第3の同様の物体を複数が目撃。報告は他資料で確認済み。 (2) 同日10:00、Jannette M. Scottは同様に銀色の円盤状物体2個（後に1個）が高度約8,000ft、300–400mphで北西（Mojave方向）へ飛行し、その後1個がきつい円を描いたと報告。騒音は聞かれず、他情報源で確認済み。 (3) 同日09:45、S/Sgt Joseph Ruvoloは高度約7,500–8,000ft、350–400mphで北西へ飛ぶ2個の銀色ソーサー状物体を目撃。音なしで気球ではないと断言し、他資料で確認済み。 (4) 同日正午頃、Major Richard R. Shoopは北方5–8マイルにて金属光沢の薄い物体を約8分間観察。高度は高め、移動はゆっくりで上下に振動しながら地表近くまで降下し再上昇。追跡機大の大きさ、金属様の外観。 (5) 1947年7月7日10:10、Major J. C. Wise（試験操縦士）は北方約10,000–12,000ftで直径5–10ft、黄白色の球状物を観察。速度約200–225mphで西から東へ進み、前方に振動するような回転運動（高度維持）を示した。最初は気球と思われたが、その後の運動で疑問を持ったと記載。いずれの報告もスケッチ・写真はなし。
summaryEn: Multiple UFO sightings were reported at Muroc Army Air Field (Muroc AAFld), California on 7–8 July 1947. Key reports: (1) 8 July ~09:30 — 1st Lt Joseph C. McHenry observed two silver disc- or sphere-like objects at about 8,000 ft, ~300 mph, heading ~320° (north). S/Sgt Gerald E. Nauman, T/Sgt Joseph Ruvolo and Jannette M. Scott corroborated the sighting; later a third similar object was seen circling at ~8,000 ft. Report noted as confirmed by other sources. (2) 8 July 10:00 — Jannette M. Scott reported two (then one) silver disc objects at ~8,000 ft, 300–400 mph, heading northwest toward Mojave; one later made a tight circular turn; no engine noise heard. Confirmed by other sources. (3) 8 July ~09:45 — S/Sgt Joseph Ruvolo observed two silver saucer/disc-shaped objects at 7,500–8,000 ft, 350–400 mph, northwest; no sound and not believed to be balloons; confirmed by other sources. (4) 8 July ~noon — Major Richard R. Shoop saw one thin metallic-looking object 5–8 miles north, observed about eight minutes at fairly high altitude moving slowly, oscillating down toward the surface then climbing; size comparable to a pursuit airplane. (5) 7 July 10:10 — Major J. C. Wise (test pilot) observed a yellowish-white spherical object 5–10 ft diameter at 10,000–12,000 ft, 200–225 mph, west-to-east, exhibiting an oscillating forward-whirling motion while maintaining altitude; initially assumed to be a weather balloon. No sketches or photographs were reported.
